title: Extract non-contiguous Java method regions into one helper
wanted_capability: A guarded Java extraction primitive that accepts multiple ordered method-body ranges for one logical concern, validates dataflow/control-flow, and extracts them into one helper when the concern is interleaved with other setup code.
fallback_used: The probe selected the largest contiguous sub-region and stopped when that sub-region still had multiple live-out locals.
notes: Generic finding from a private UI-builder probe. The logical concern was spread across several non-adjacent blocks, while the current primitive accepts one contiguous block.
